scope: Corollary 17.6 (Macroscopic contacts) of the manuscript “Conformal Limits of Critical Square-Lattice Random-Cluster Interfaces” (preprints/Conformal-Limits-of-Critical-Square-Lattice-Random-Cluster-Interfaces-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b14b09c2088272ae), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 106. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In any tight subsequential limit of actual loops or Dobrushin strands, the interior set of genuinely distinct visits by macroscopic curves has Hausdorff dimension at most zero, almost surely. Constant parametrization pauses are discarded. No assertion about boundary contacts is made here.
